images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 top-down screenshot of a letter-based deduction game. A dark walnut desk under a warm desk lamp. Two handwritten letters on cream lined paper: the current one lies in front, written in blue-black fountain-pen hand with one sentence highlighted in yellow and a red pencil circle and margin note; an older letter sits rotated behind it, its handwriting visibly slanted. A heavy brass magnifying loupe with a wooden handle rests on the page, enlarging a single handwritten Hangul syllable so its stroke shape is obvious. A dark translucent panel top-right compares the same syllable from both letters side by side, the new one outlined in yellow. At the bottom, three index-card reply options with coloured tags fan out, the middle one lifted and highlighted. Small pill meters top-left for letters received, trust hearts and suspicion dots. Korean UI: "펜팔 추리", "필체 비교", "떠보기". Warm cinematic still-life realism, walnut brown, cream paper, ink blue, lamp amber, film grain, vignette.

images.screen: B · 진실 — 코르크보드에 증거를 잇고 결론을 봉인한다
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Landscape 16:9 front-on screenshot of the reveal screen in a letter-based deduction game. A framed cork evidence board fills the view. Three torn strips of handwritten letters are pinned across the top with red map pins; below, instant-photo crops of the same handwritten syllable from two letters and a crop of a miswritten name in Chinese characters, all linked by taut red string with three numbered red discrepancy markers. A black label in the corner counts the handwriting mismatches. In the lower centre a dark verdict card with a red spine states who really wrote the letters, and beside it a large glossy red wax seal button with irregular melted edges waits to be pressed. Korean UI: "필체 불일치 3곳", "진실", "봉인". Detective-noir warmth, cork tan and walnut, cream paper, crimson string and wax, soft top light, film grain, vignette.
